name: node-agent
description: A complete agent you run yourself: one bus, nodes in one process, and a Web UI

scripts.build: npm run build -w @node-agent/sdk && npm run build -w node-agent-bus && npm run build -w @node-agent/runtime && npm run build -w node-agent-agent && npm run build -w node-agent-history && npm run build -w node-agent-provider && npm run build -w @node-agent/shell && npm run build -w node-agent-system && npm run build -w node-agent-webui && npm run build -w node-agent-notes && npm run build -w node-agent-todo && npm run build -w node-agent-timer && npm run build -w node-agent-search && npm run build -w node-agent-introduce && npm run build -w @node-agent/local && npm run build -w node-agent-example
